main.description: Main source file to compile (.p8 or .pb)

outputDir.description: Output directory for compiled files (relative to project folder)

launchEmu.description: Launch emulator after successful compilation (uses compiler -emu flag)

run.description: Custom script or executable to run after compilation (alternative to launchEmu). Environment variables PRG_PATH and PROJECT_DIR will be set.

compilerPath.description: Path to prog8c compiler (executable or .jar file). Overrides extension setting.

javaPath.description: Path to Java executable (only needed if compiler is a .jar file). Overrides extension setting.

tassPath.description: Folder containing the 64tass assembler binary. Overrides extension setting.

emulatorPath.description: Folder containing emulators (x16emu, x64sc, x128, xpet). Overrides extension setting.

keywordCasing.description: Automatically format ProgB keywords to the specified casing style
enumDescriptions: Camel Case - End If, Module, Dim

formatCommaSpacing.description: Automatically add a space after commas in ProgB code
